set.body: Hosted Checks39556719904: rootJS tests succeeded, but tools/check-docs.py refused seven existing unclassified docs: NUMERICAL_REPRODUCIBILITY, DENSITY_APPROXIMATION, DISTANCE_CORRELATION, ARCHIVE_MEMORY, DOMAIN_CONSTRUCTORS, MULTIMATCH_ALIGNMENT, PROJECT_PREREQUISITES. Confirmed all seven files already exist on origin/main e1e6c95e and are absent from its tools/doc-examples.json pages map. Review their scope and register as public guide, preserving strict completeness and executable-evidence checks. They have no Scala fences or linked Scala example sources. Do not classify internal to bypass validation. Run static checker, actual platform CI and final post-merge docs checks; close after landing.
set.title: Register the seven missing public contract guides in documentation coverage
